name: 1Password desktop
what: Usage data (telemetry) about how the apps are used, never vault contents. The choice is stored per account on the server and syncs to all devices. Individual and family accounts must consent; Teams and Business accounts can have it on by default.

steps: Desktop app: select your account at the top of the sidebar > Manage Accounts > choose the account > Usage data: clear "Share information about your usage". Do this for each account.
Or on 1Password.com: your name > Manage Account > Usage Data: clear the share option.
Teams and Business: only an owner can turn it off, in Settings on 1Password.com.
